put.summary: Link a global trigger repository to the project, or replace its settings
put.description: A new watcher does not touch work in flight, so the first time needs no lock. The link's cursor starts after the latest pull request stored for the repository, or at the link's creation when there is none. For an active link, the stored pull requests after it are backfilled into triggers. When it is linked already the project's settings are replaced (fields left out take their defaults, the cursor stays), which needs the project locked and drained. Refused when it would watch where results land. revoked is not accepted: only PATCH sets it. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

200.description: The link existed: its settings are replaced

400.description: Invalid body

409.description: The link exists and the project is not locked, or has tasks in flight (their ids are in details)

patch.description: watch_dir, base_branch and enabled need the project locked and drained. revoked is admin only and takes effect at once. Enabling or un-revoking backfills triggers; a watch_dir or base_branch change does not. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.
